reason: Celerion is a 55-year-old global contract research organization (early-phase clinical trials and bioanalytical labs for pharma sponsors, corporate HQ Lincoln NE with 300+ clinical staff at that site alone plus offices in AZ, PA, Montreal, Belfast, Zurich and Vienna) — a services business far too large for a fractional engagement and in the wrong vertical: it sells drug-development services, not a connected hardware product with a companion mobile app. Every live posting in today's fresh ATS feed is clinical/laboratory staffing (Clinical Research Coordinator, Clinical Research Nurse, Bioanalytical Laboratory Technician, Medical Research Assistant, Custodian, Medical Admissions Specialist); the only technical role, EDC Developer / Programmer, is clinical-database administration ('administration of EDC Database including evaluation, analysis, design', eCRF build for sponsor trials) — an internal data-capture system, not a BLE device app, not an iOS/Android codebase aging past a store deadline, and not a first companion app with nobody aboard who has shipped regulated mobile. No line in any live posting redescribes the pain David Sowsy fixes, so there is nothing quotable and no fit.
